---
title: Claude Code, Cursor and other coding agents
description: Add the WriteStack MCP server to Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code or any client that reads an MCP config file.
---

Clients that support remote MCP servers over HTTP connect with OAuth: add the URL and sign in when asked. Clients that only run local servers use `mcp-remote` with an [API key](/docs/build/connect/api-key).

## Claude Code

```bash
claude mcp add --transport http writestack https://www.writestack.io/api/mcp/mcp
```

Then run `/mcp` inside Claude Code and choose **writestack** to sign in.

## Cursor, VS Code and other config-file clients

Add the server to the client's MCP config (for Cursor, `~/.cursor/mcp.json`):

```json title="mcp.json"
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "writestack": {
      "url": "https://www.writestack.io/api/mcp/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```

The client opens WriteStack the first time a tool is used. Sign in and approve access.

## Clients without remote or OAuth support

Use `mcp-remote` with an API key header. Create the key in **Settings → MCP** (see [API key](/docs/build/connect/api-key)):

```json title="mcp.json"
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "writestack": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": [
        "-y",
        "mcp-remote",
        "https://www.writestack.io/api/mcp/mcp",
        "--header",
        "Authorization: Bearer ws_your_api_key"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

WriteStack shows this config, with your key filled in, right after you generate a key.

## Notes for coding agents

- Read [agent rules](/docs/build/agent-rules) and the [tool reference](/docs/build/mcp-reference) before scripting against the server.
- The legacy SSE path (`/api/mcp/mcp/sse`) returns HTTP 405. Use the endpoint above.
